typography.display: Noto Serif SC / Source Han Serif SC / SimSun
typography.body: Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei UI / PingFang SC

color.evidence: Deep blue belongs only to the evidence surface

shared_visual_core.material: Subtle CSS paper grain with no nested rounded cards, glass panels or large floating shadows
shared_visual_core.shape_and_line: A flat editorial sheet organized by rules, square fields and shared alignments
shared_visual_core.image_treatment: The confirmed original author uses a local project-owned circular avatar; the evidence diagram is original HTML/CSS and contains no text baked into an image
shared_visual_core.hierarchy_and_rhythm: Serif display claim, concise sans-serif deck, evidence stage, vermilion takeaway rule and quiet creator line

static_composition.structure: Claim, evidence and takeaway form one complete page with the evidence field as the single visual anchor
static_composition.variants: Portrait, landscape and square share content fields but use separate grid relationships and a dedicated square short title
static_composition.thumbnail: The active title remains the first readable text at 360px output width
static_composition.capture: Select each requested output variant from editable-media.json and capture it from the same HTML

time_motion.carrier: The three evidence steps move from separated offsets into one aligned subject-to-layout-to-result chain inside the stable evidence surface
time_motion.states: Start shows unresolved separation; change establishes shared alignment; result completes the chain and grows the takeaway rule; hold preserves the readable result
time_motion.energy: Restrained editorial movement with short translation and line growth, without page-level floating, camera motion or decorative looping
time_motion.reduced_motion: Show the aligned result with the stable takeaway rule

interaction.mode: Hybrid preview controls remain outside the media canvas
interaction.controls: Previous, play, pause and next use the existing editable-media runtime
interaction.feedback: Only short color and opacity feedback; controls never create a second semantic timeline
